title: Can Aligned LLMs Jailbreak Themselves? Inside the SLIP Attack
description: Yes. In our COLM 2026 paper, aligned LLMs jailbreak themselves via SLIP: 94.7% average attack success on AdvBench across 11 models, with about 7.9 queries.

title: RAG That Learns Over Time: Source Learning for LLM Agents
description: SourceLearn builds RAG that learns over time: a persistent source model beat Hybrid RAG by up to 22.6 points, best in 13 of 15 settings.

title: Agent Primitives: Reusable Latent Building Blocks for Multi-Agent Systems
description: Agent Primitives (ICML 2026): reusable latent building blocks for LLM multi-agent systems, composed by an Organizer and connected via KV-cache communication.

title: The Hidden Cost of Prompt Injection Defense
description: Prompt injection defenses are scored on attack success, which hides lost content. SecFid (ICML 2026 Spotlight) measures both security and fidelity.

title: How to Test Whether Your Product Descriptions Influence AI Shopping Recommendations
description: A step-by-step protocol for testing whether product descriptions change AI shopping recommendations, using the CORE method and ProductBench.

title: CORE: Controlling Output Rankings in Generative Engines for LLM-based Search
description: Project page for CORE: controlling output rankings in generative engines for LLM-based search, with the ProductBench benchmark and results on four LLMs.

title: CORE Explained: How to Improve Visibility in LLM-Based Search (Step by Step)
description: A step-by-step explainer of CORE, our method for studying how retrieved content changes rankings in LLM-based search, with definitions and FAQ.

title: SEO vs GEO vs CORE: Techniques for Visibility in LLM-Based Search
description: A comparison of SEO, generative engine optimization (GEO), and our CORE method for how content is ranked in LLM-based search, written by the CORE authors.

title: When More Reasoning is Actually Less: The Science Behind Optimal Thinking in LLMs
description: Why more chain-of-thought can hurt LLM accuracy: the inverted U-curve, three failure modes of reasoning, and the case for adaptive reasoning.

title: From Parameter Learning to Prompt Learning: The Evolution of Prompt Optimization
description: How prompt optimization mirrors the history of neural network training, from perturbation methods to gradient-based techniques, and what may come next.

title: 1000 Ideas for Your Next Trustworthy Machine Learning Paper
description: Three universal frameworks for generating trustworthy ML research ideas across robustness, adversarial security, interpretability, and fairness.
